transformation: First-party paraphrases of six selected native remarks. Native IDs and action levels are unchanged. Full provider packets and account/session metadata are not redistributed. This is not a complete raw provider report.

selected_findings.paraphrased_observation: Direct copies leave a skill destination that blocks retry. The maintainer supplied this reproduction before the review. Staging was already considered in planning.
selected_findings.disposition: Handled failures recover conservatively; staged and installed bytes are checked.

selected_findings.paraphrased_observation: The first test failed before a destination was created. That alone could not catch partial-copy cleanup or preservation mistakes.
selected_findings.disposition: Added partial-copy, publication-position, content-change, conflict and cleanup-failure tests.

selected_findings.paraphrased_observation: Recovery instructions were useful, but the existing guide already disclosed that compact downloads omit tests.
selected_findings.disposition: The compact guide now explains safe recovery and explicitly retained uncertainty.

selected_findings.paraphrased_observation: The asserted project-root glob did not cover the preferred .agents staging parent. Other tests already detected some leftovers.
selected_findings.disposition: Strengthened assertions to inspect the actual staging locations.

selected_findings.paraphrased_observation: In the reviewed d5a66ce snapshot, a directory scan could mask the primary copy error.
selected_findings.disposition: Follow-up c3ce75c retains the primary error and records secondary bookkeeping errors separately. Uncertainty keeps safe_to_retry false.

selected_findings.paraphrased_observation: The wrapper retains the original exception through __cause__, while direct Python callers would need that chain to recover its type and metadata.
selected_findings.disposition: No stable Python SDK compatibility claim is made. This observation is retained rather than presented as fixed or refuted.

rejected_recommendation_detail: On the tested macOS filesystem, plain os.rename could replace an existing empty destination. Exclusive destination creation was used instead.
